content:
**OPNduck v0.2.0-Pre-Alpha** 🦆

First tagged release - the local-first media suite's frontend shell, rebuilt on the new "Liquid Glass" design system.

**Highlights**
• Theme engine simplified down to **Glass** and **Monochrome** (Flat theme removed)
• Fixed a long-standing CSS containing-block bug - the Settings category rail now correctly follows scroll (via a React portal)
• De-cliché UI pass: dropped all-caps labels, middle-dot separators, and identical nested cards in favor of divider-lists
• Card hover-lift/glow is now respects the Reduce Motion setting
• Fixed a dev-tool (GlassTune) theme-leak bug bleeding Glass colors into other themes
• General cleanup and simplification across the settings components

Verified clean via `tsc -b`, `vite build`, and `oxlint` at every step.

This is still shell-only pre-alpha - download/convert/AI engines land in the Alpha phase. Expect bugs.
